description: Send a text message to a contact on any connected platform: a WhatsApp number (international format without +, e.g. 201234567890), or the `phone` / `chat_id` of a website chat, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, X or SMS contact exactly as get_conversations_awaiting_reply or get_contacts returns it. The message goes out on the platform the contact wrote from.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to send this message.

phone.description: WhatsApp number in international format without + (e.g. 201234567890), or the contact's phone / chat_id as listed (e.g. wc1-d838cd71… for a website chat visitor)

name: send_text_message
